scope: Thirty-six fresh native Scalding Rain, Voltic Bolt and Zap recordings only.
method: Read-only byte, JSON, and offline serialized-zone comparison; no game actions, native PHP execution, or native writes.
oracleLineage: Printed flat card text determines base damage; actual target choice and paid AB1 determine target/reduction. All original numeric/resource/AP/equipment assertions remain an identical prefix. Values were not inferred from fresh outputs.
classification: Every final change is the previously reviewed source-resolution lifecycle effect ordering and final source reference. All other serialized fields and all turn-effect multisets remain unchanged. Fresh finals equal earlier diagnostic actuals; no expected snapshots were written by this review.
explicitZeroCredit: The fully prevented blue Zap preserves an explicit caster1-to-target2 zero credit per the existing native counter contract.
approvalLimit: These existing scenarios and appended attribution/cleanup checks are approved. Deterministic current-runtime replay is a separate parent-owned gate; this is not comprehensive coverage of all abilities, external listeners or replacements.
